title: Mercedes-Benz signs low-carbon aluminum deal, updates climate targets
extract: A long-term Norsk Hydro supply agreement will cover at least 10% of Mercedes-Benz's primary aluminium needs, with a target of lowering the material's emissions by 2030.

title: Google to introduce two variants of its in-house chips, Bloomberg News reports
extract: Bloomberg reports Google is preparing 8tx and 8i Max TPU variants aimed at large AI workloads, coding agents and customers that need stronger hardware security.

title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
extract: Meta says Muse Ember is its smallest, most cost-efficient model yet, tuned for agent execution, tool use, coding subtasks and long-document processing.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
extract: Anthropic's new model pair targets coding, reasoning and vision; the company reports faster generation and lower token use on demanding tasks, with Mythos access restricted to selected research and security programmes.

title: Disney and Adobe are building generative AI tools together
extract: The multiyear partnership gives Disney early access to Adobe's generative-AI technology and aims to build artist-led models for creative production, theme parks, cruises and ESPN.

title: Apple's $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
extract: Apple has introduced a $49.99 top-up for usage-limited AI features in Logic Pro, with the same credit-style approach expected to spread across Creator Studio apps.

title: Parents and teachers decry Google pledge to yank Search if schools block AI
extract: Google's policy would also disable Search for school accounts that block its AI tools, prompting educators to question the company's leverage over classroom technology and student data.

title: EU sues IBM and two European firms over troubled entry/exit border system
extract: EU-Lisa is suing IBM, Atos and Leonardo over delays in developing the Entry/Exit System; the case concerns delivery failures, not the system's current operation.

title: Epic Games Launcher is coming to SteamOS
extract: Epic's new launcher will support SteamOS and other Linux distributions, a notable step for Steam Deck users, although Fortnite support remains uncertain because of anti-cheat compatibility.

title: AMD FSR 4.1 officially arrives on Xbox Series X|S
extract: AMD's FSR 4.1 upscaler is now available to Xbox Series X|S developers through the latest GDK, bringing its image-quality and performance improvements to console builds.

title: Quote of the day by Shigeru Miyamoto: 'There are two types of games – well-made games and interesting games'
extract: A resurfaced 1996 interview captures Miyamoto weighing polish against originality, offering a look back at the design thinking behind Nintendo's early 3D era.

title: Nintendo of America invests in game preservation as it looks to hire an archivist
extract: Nintendo of America is seeking an archivist to preserve its history and institutional knowledge, a notable step toward formalising the company's game and hardware preservation.

title: Fan preserves Namco's 2011 Japan-only mobile game Pac-Man SP
extract: A preservationist has rescued Namco's Japan-only 2011 mobile Pac-Man SP, a title long unavailable commercially, and plans to add it to the Keitai World Launcher archive.

title: Dolphin Depot is a new Nintendo GameCube homebrew app launcher that works on real hardware
extract: The beta launcher lets GameCube owners browse and install homebrew apps on original hardware, including emulators, game launchers and resolution tools.

title: 18 Nintendo Game & Watch classics come to ZX Spectrum via SM510 emulator
extract: A new SM510 emulator brings 18 Game & Watch titles, including Mario Bros. and Donkey Kong, to the ZX Spectrum and original 48K hardware.

title: A Golden Wake is getting a reimagining, 12 years after its original release
extract: Grundislav Games is reimagining its 2014 point-and-click adventure with refreshed art, new puzzles, characters, locations, voice acting and music.

title: Portal 2's cancelled F-Stop prototype is now playable
extract: A playable reconstruction of F-Stop, the cancelled Portal 2 prequel concept, has surfaced, reviving a 2007-era prototype that explored a different mechanic from the finished game.

title: M John Harrison becomes first science fiction author to win the Booker prize
extract: Harrison's post-apocalyptic novel The End of Everything, set on the near-future Kent coast, has won the £50,000 Booker Prize, making him the first science-fiction author to take the award.

title: Lessons in Harmony by Jonathan Coe review – what can music tell us about national identity?
extract: Coe's historical novel follows the friendship between Maurice Ravel and Ralph Vaughan Williams from Paris in 1907 through the world wars, using music to explore national identity.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero takes US box office by storm in opening weekend
extract: The 39th Godzilla film opened with $31.6m in North America and $63m worldwide, setting a record for the biggest opening weekend by a live-action foreign-language film.

title: New Blade Runner 2099 trailer sees Hunter Schafer go undercover as humanity's last hope
extract: The new trailer shows Hunter Schafer's Cora going undercover amid a replicant takeover in Los Angeles, offering a fuller look at the upcoming Philip K. Dick-inspired series.

title: Adam Driver finally said yes to Marvel for X-Men because he was a 'big fan' and the script was 'really cool'
extract: Driver says his childhood love of the X-Men comics and TV series, plus Jake Schreier's pitch and a strong script, persuaded him to play Mr. Sinister in Marvel's new film.

title: Hideo Kojima has high praise for season 2 of Netflix's Keira Knightley-led spy thriller
extract: Kojima calls Black Doves season two an outstanding British spy thriller, praising its writing, Knightley and Whishaw, and its treatment of spies and assassins.

title: A one-part wonder! The West End's streamlined Harry Potter and the Cursed Child works like magic
extract: The West End production has been condensed from two parts and five hours into a single three-hour show, retaining the spectacle and performances of the fantasy hit.

title: Donnie Dunagan, original voice of Disney's Bambi and triple Purple Heart marine, dies aged 92
extract: Dunagan voiced young Bambi at six before serving 25 years in the Marines and earning three Purple Hearts, linking a classic animation role with an extraordinary later life.

title: 'We did 10 takes of it!' Kerr Smith on Dawson's Creek and filming US TV's first gay kiss
extract: Smith revisits the landmark 2000 Dawson's Creek storyline in his memoir, recalling the filming of US network television's first gay kiss and the reaction that followed.

title: 'Sadistic, forbidden pleasure': why Gone Girl is my feelgood movie
extract: Rosamund Pike explains why David Fincher's 2014 psychological thriller has become an unlikely comfort watch, revisiting its dark humour, revenge plot and precise unease.

title: Robert Pattinson has auditioned for James Bond – and finally the 007 race is interesting
extract: Reports that Pattinson auditioned alongside Nicholas Hoult and Josh O'Connor give the long-running 007 casting search a fresh set of contenders, with the article weighing the unusual screen presence he could bring.

title: Soul Patrol review – heart-stopping story of Vietnam's first Black special ops team
extract: The documentary follows an all-Black six-man reconnaissance patrol in Vietnam, drawing on a member's memoir, home movies, interviews and a reunion to revisit their service and the racism they faced.

title: Square Enix reveals Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle for mobile
extract: Square Enix has announced a new mobile Dragon Quest RPG for iOS and Android, with an announcement trailer scheduled for 10 November and further details still to come.
